comparison.objective: Measure voltage by simultaneously probing designated L and N terminal openings.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually align and hold two fine probes in crowded openings.
comparison.success_condition: Both probes remain seated in the correct terminals for one second; any wrong opening invalidates the run.
comparison.reason: Shares fine coaxial tool placement, but tests simultaneous electrical probing and wrong-terminal avoidance, not impact fracture and post-fracture recovery.
